name: harby-lukmancylyk-hasabaty
description: Aýratyn gözegçilikde saklamak — special-monitoring registry (Vite+React frontend, Express/SQLite backend), with a Windows 7/8/8.1 x86 desktop installer

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.desktop: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dist --prefix desktop
